pre_freeze_knowledge.outer_results: Original genre outcomes, confidence/missingness/feature diagnostics already inspected; exploratory nested reuse, not fresh confirmatory cohort.
pre_freeze_knowledge.inner_hash_census: One proposed label-blind hash inspected before freeze; all 15 training cells pass >=5 positive-vote components/class; minimum 8. Hash was not chosen among reseeds.

unchanged: Full 11565 metadata identities, artist+album components, original five outer folds/salt, 1024 eligible rows/368 components, fractional targets including disagreement, three original methods, train-only genre/instrument vocabulary, alpha1 NB, component-unit training weights, outer support gates. No moods/human taxonomy/IDs/titles/duration as features.

inner_folds.cohort: Eligible outer-training rows only. Whole complete-metadata components retained; outer heldout labels never used for gates, fits, selection or temperature.
inner_folds.fit_gate: Every class positive in >=5 distinct inner-training components. Each validation row held out from its own inner fit; every eligible outer-training row must have exactly one inner OOF prediction. No validation-class gate.

selection.objective: Fractional log loss, average eligible rows within each outer-training component then equally across all such components. Pool complete OOF rows, not equally weighted fold scores.
selection.ties: Exact computed loss ties select smaller temperature, no epsilon.
selection.failure: If any inner training gate fails or complete OOF coverage fails, use T=1 identity fallback with explicit reason; do not score/select candidates or abstain original baseline/query outcomes.
selection.transformation: softmax(raw nine-class Bernoulli NB logits / T) using logsumexp. Empty vocabulary raw logits=log(training prior); T1 uses original NB probabilities byte-exactly, otherwise soften prior by same transformation.
selection.no_search: No expanded grid, reseeding, class selection, calibration variant, feature tuning or outer-outcome selection.

fit_budget.outer: Refit unchanged full outer model once to prove exact old model and baseline prediction equality; selected temperature then applies to raw logits of that same model.

metrics.primary: Component-equal fractional logloss difference temperature_nb minus genre_instrument_nb.
metrics.secondary: Component-equal and track-weighted individual-vote Brier and fractional logloss for all four matched methods; descriptive per-class support/probability/logloss.
metrics.clip: 1e-15 inside logloss only; exact probabilities for Brier, no renormalization; report clipped positive-target class cells/tracks.

bootstrap.unit: Paired scored components, shared draws across all four methods, both scopes/metrics; all six pairwise method differences; fixed predictions, no retraining uncertainty.

diagnostics.boundaries: Left closed/right open except last right closed.
diagnostics.confidence: max predicted probability; class-order argmax ties.
diagnostics.agreement: Human fractional vote mass on argmax class.
diagnostics.weights: Eligible scored row weight 1/n_eligible_in_component; normalize globally for overall statistics and renormalize within each bin.
diagnostics.report: All methods confidence/agreement/bin counts and component mass; per-class row-vote/component-vote mass, predicted class mass and classwise logloss; target missingness and genre/instrument sampling. Never use diagnostics/ECE to select.

rights.attribution: Music Technology Group; Bogdanov, Won, Tovstogan, Porter and Serra (2019), The MTG-Jamendo Dataset for Automatic Music Tagging; Music Classification Annotations documentation
rights.commit: Code, protocols and restrained aggregates only. Raw source, inner logits/models and per-track predictions remain local. No serving or deployment.

interpretation: Exploratory nested reuse of known historical outer outcomes. No fresh confirmatory cohort, causal diagnosis, relevance/listener retrieval validation, general calibration guarantee or EveryNoise parity claim. No further outcome-based method changes.
